observations.behavior: Adds a new boolean field inherit_profile_spill to the Table model, with a comment explaining its purpose.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows HogQL to opt out of HogQL's default max_bytes_before_external_group_by=0, enabling ClickHouse spill thresholds to apply.

observations.behavior: Sets inherit_profile_spill to True for LogEntriesTable, with a comment explaining why this table needs spill.
observations.posthog_connection: Log entries live on a single-shard aux cluster, so wide-window GROUP BYs cannot rely on shard fan-out and must be able to spill to disk.
